title: Text animations
summary: Comic lettering that moves: shouted Bangers caps, inked and extruded, that slam, whip and letter themselves on over flat-colour panels with Ben-Day dots, bursts, zoom lines, slabs, caption boxes and balloons.
usage: Title cards fill the frame (any shape from square to 9:16): use one as a shot’s "background" (a candidate may then omit "visual") or as its "visual", e.g. {"background": {"piece": "text/headline-slam", "props": {"lines": ["YOUR", "WORDS"], "accent": "yellow"}}}, or as a footage "cutaway". Overlays are see-through, in 1080×1920 frame pixels: {"piece": "text/keyword-slam", "start": 1.2, "end": 3.4, "props": {"word": "FOCUS", "y": 330}}. Every word and position is a prop, with the same names as the other themes; "accent" (yellow, red, blue, green, purple, teal, orange, paper) picks the panel colour of a card or the plate colour of an overlay. Kit: library/themes/comic/kit.js. Files: library/themes/comic/text/pieces/.

items.name: Headline slam
items.description: A cover line slams on letter by letter over a two-colour burst and zoom lines, with a caption box, a balloon and edge tags.

items.name: Split stack
items.description: Two stacked words whip in from opposite sides with speed streaks and a tilted picture panel pops between them.

items.name: Marquee wall
items.description: A tilted wall of printed bands in flat colours, each running its words sideways in alternating directions.

items.name: Statement
items.description: A sentence lettered on word by word in shouted caps; the emphasised word lands harder with a burst behind it.

items.name: Big number
items.description: One huge figure counts up inside a burst with zoom lines, a caption box above and a slab label below.

items.name: Quote card
items.description: A quotation in one big speech balloon that pops open line by line, with oversized quote marks and the speaker on a slab.

items.name: Agenda
items.description: A numbered list as paper strips that pop out one at a time with burst numbers; the item being read turns yellow.

items.name: Versus
items.description: The panel is torn in two colours along a slanted gutter; two words whip in and a burst with the mark pops on the tear.

items.name: Chapter
items.description: A chapter number lands huge in a burst, a caption box on its corner and the title lettered onto a slab.

items.name: Countdown
items.description: Every beat is an impact: zoom lines rush in and the next number slams down in a burst of the next colour.

items.name: End card
items.description: The sign-off slams on over a burst, the call to action nudges on a slab, the handle speaks from a balloon and a band runs along the bottom.

items.name: Keyword slam
items.description: One shouted word slams down letter by letter over a burst (or a slab), with a flash of zoom lines and a caption box.

items.name: Highlight swipe
items.description: A sentence in inked caps; a marker slab whips in behind the words that matter.

items.name: Lower third
items.description: A lopsided name slab pops out from a point, a dark plate drops out under it and both letter themselves on.

items.name: Side text
items.description: A tall slab shoots up one edge of the frame like a comic’s spine, its words lettered along it.

items.name: Marquee band
items.description: A printed band snaps open across the frame with its words running sideways between sparks.

items.name: Corner labels
items.description: Cover small print: a caption box pops into each corner of the frame, with a burst badge.

items.name: PiP frame
items.description: An inset comic panel frame (paper gutter, ink box, hard shadow) pops open around a window, with a slab label and caption.

items.name: Sticker
items.description: A two-colour cover burst with dots is slapped on, spins to rest and keeps boiling, with a ribbon caption.
